ignore.title: Ignore patterns
ignore.hint: Files and folders matching these patterns are never scanned. Hidden and system files are always excluded.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.statement: Ordino sends file names and metadata to your chosen AI provider — never file contents.
privacy.localNote: With a local endpoint like Ollama, nothing leaves your machine at all.

errors.SCAN_FAILED: Couldn't scan the folder. Try again.
errors.FOLDER_NOT_DIRECTORY: That's a file, not a folder.
errors.FOLDER_NOT_READABLE: Ordino doesn't have permission to read this folder.
errors.FOLDER_STATE_NOT_WRITABLE: Ordino can't write its state into this folder — is it read-only?
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: No AI provider is configured yet.
errors.PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE: Couldn't reach the AI provider. Check your connection or provider settings.
errors.PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED: The API key was rejected — check it's copied completely.
errors.PROVIDER_BAD_ENDPOINT: That URL doesn't look like an OpenAI-compatible endpoint — did you forget /v1?
errors.PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The AI provider took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.CLAUDE_NOT_INSTALLED: Claude Code isn't installed — install it from claude.com/claude-code, or switch to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
errors.CLAUDE_NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Claude Code isn't signed in — open a terminal and run `claude` once.
errors.CLAUDE_SPAWN_FAILED: Claude Code couldn't be started. Check the binary path in Settings.
errors.PLAN_MALFORMED: The model returned an unusable plan. Trying again usually fixes this.
errors.PLAN_EMPTY: The model returned an empty plan.
errors.UNDO_NOT_AVAILABLE: There's nothing to undo for this folder.
errors.JOURNAL_CORRUPT: This folder's Ordino history file is damaged and was reset.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: Something sent an invalid request — this is a bug in Ordino.
